name: Easy Thai
notes: All 3 photos were legible printed menu boards (Salad, Noodles, Soup sections); no duplicates to merge.

dishes.name: Som Tum (Thai)
dishes.description: One of Thailand's most beloved salads. Freshly hand-shredded green papaya tossed with tomato, green beans, finished with a bold chili-lime dressing of garlic, fish sauce, bird's eye chili, and roasted peanuts.

dishes.name: Som Tum (Lao Style)
dishes.description: The original, bold version of spicy papaya salad. Hand-shredded green papaya tossed with fermented fish sauce, green beans, Thai eggplant and tomato, finished with a punchy chili-lime dressing.

dishes.name: Beef Salad (Yum Nua)
dishes.description: Sliced beef tossed with cashews, red onion, green onion, fresh chili, tomato, cucumber, and lettuce, finished with a bright chili-lime dressing.

dishes.name: Larb Salad
dishes.description: Choice of tofu, ground chicken, or ground pork $13.95; ground beef or pork belly $15.95. A dry salad seasoned with lime juice, fish sauce, ground roasted chili powder, roasted rice powder, mint, cilantro, and chopped red onion. Served with green leaf lettuce.

dishes.name: Glass Noodle Salad
dishes.description: Glass noodles tossed with ground pork, shrimp, red onion, and cilantro in a bold chili-lime dressing with fish sauce and Thai chili.

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $13.95, Beef/Mock Duck/Shrimp/Squid $15.95, Pork Belly $16.95, Combo (chicken, beef, shrimp) $17.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $17.95. Rice noodles stir-fried in our house tamarind sauce with eggs, chives, and bean sprouts, finished with roasted peanuts. Straight-up Thai classic.

dishes.name: Drunken Noodles
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $13.95, Beef/Mock Duck/Shrimp/Squid $15.95, Pork Belly $16.95, Combo (chicken, beef, shrimp) $17.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $17.95. Fresh wide rice noodles wok-fried in a house sauce with garlic, Thai chili, onion, bell peppers, carrots and Thai basil. Hot, bold, and full of kick.

dishes.name: Pad See Ew
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $13.95, Beef/Mock Duck/Shrimp/Squid $15.95, Pork Belly $16.95, Combo (chicken, beef, shrimp) $17.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $17.95. Fresh wide rice noodles stir-fried with garlic, sweet dark soy, eggs, carrots, and broccoli. Smoky, rich, and easy to love.

dishes.name: Chow Mein
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $13.95, Beef/Mock Duck/Shrimp/Squid $15.95, Pork Belly $16.95, Combo (chicken, beef, shrimp) $17.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $17.95. Pan-fried egg noodles with bean sprouts, broccoli, scallion, cabbage, and carrots. Simple street-style comfort.

dishes.name: Tom Yum Soup
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $6.95, Mock Duck/Shrimp or Squid $7.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $9.95. Classic Thai hot-and-sour soup with mushrooms, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and roasted chili paste. Bright, bold, and finished with fresh cilantro.

dishes.name: Tom Kha Soup
dishes.description: Choose your protein: Chicken/Veggies/Tofu $6.95, Mock Duck/Shrimp or Squid $7.95, Seafood (shrimp, squid, mussel, fish) $9.95. Creamy coconut milk soup with mushrooms, galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and lime juice. Smooth, comforting, topped with fresh cilantro.

dishes.name: Wonton Soup
dishes.description: Small $7.95 / Large $15.95. House-made wontons filled with pork, shrimp, and yellow chives, served in a clear chicken broth with broccoli and carrot. Simple and comforting.
